patterns.note: Consistent two-column grid for product introductions and feature explanations, often alternating image and text positions to maintain visual interest.
A stark, high-contrast palette of white, black, and a vibrant red for all interactive elements and accents, creating a disciplined and modern feel.
A dual-level sticky header system, where both the main navigation and a secondary product-category navigation remain fixed at the top after initial scroll.
Dedicated sections for 'Why Vitsoe?', 'Lifelong service', and 'What our customers say' use a consistent structure of a main heading followed by a grid of smaller content blocks or a large quote.
Clear typographic hierarchy with bold, medium-sized headings and legible body text, complemented by smaller uppercase labels for navigation and sub-headings.

technique_notes: The site uses a clean, minimalist layout with ample whitespace to highlight content and product imagery, emphasizing clarity and functionality.

A dual-level sticky header is implemented, where the main navigation and a secondary product-category navigation both become fixed at the top of the viewport after the user scrolls past the initial hero content.
Interactive elements like 'Learn more' links and CTAs are consistently highlighted with a vibrant red color and an arrow icon, ensuring clear calls to action.

design_tokens.type_scale: Clear hierarchy with bold, medium-sized headings (~2-3x body text) and legible body text, with smaller uppercase labels for navigation and sub-headings.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners throughout for all elements and images.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced and airy, with generous vertical spacing between sections and within content blocks, creating a sense of order and clarity.

standout: The site's standout feature is its uncompromisingly minimalist and functional aesthetic, reminiscent of classic Dieter Rams design principles. The stark white background, crisp black typography, and precise use of a single, bold red accent create a highly disciplined and authoritative brand presence that avoids visual clutter and focuses purely on the product system.
